entities.summary: Oloori Kofoworola Aina, Lady Ademola MBE, MFR, OFR was a Nigerian educationist. A writer and advocate for women's education and also the president of the National Council of Women's Societies in Nigeria, she was the head of the women's organization from 1958 to 1964. Ademola was the first black African woman to earn a degree from Oxford University, studying at St Hugh's College, and also an author of children's books.
